headline: Clinton order makes further changes to the rules for a federal advisory commission on health care consumer protection and quality.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 13017, which created an advisory commission to study consumer protection and quality in the health care industry and give advice to the President. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not known from the title alone. The word "further" shows that the earlier order had already been changed at least once before.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Advisory Commission on Consumer Protection and Quality in the Health Care Industry
who_it_affects.how: The commission's setup or rules are changed in ways the title does not describe.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, July 21, 1997, though the source does not say.
